sections.kicker: Prepared for Ayira Beauty by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way someone tired of ten step routines would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: Ayira Beauty has a brave idea and hides it under a stock headline.
sections.keep: Your line "We're here to help you need less." In a category built on more, that is a real stance.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The headline is a claim every hair brand makes.
pins.why: Healthier hair is the category's promise, so it cannot be the reason to pick Ayira.
pins.how: Lead with the stance below it instead.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Shoppers file you next to every other haircare brand and move on.

pins.quote: AYIRA BEAUTY isn't here to sell you more. We're here to help you need less.
pins.what: Your real idea sits in the small print.
pins.why: Needing less is a belief a customer can join, and it is what makes the brand yours.
pins.how: Make it the headline and let the formulas prove it.
pins.label: Your belief
pins.cost: The one line that sounds like a point of view is the one people skip.

pins.quote: Our premium formulas increase hair retention by reducing tangles and breakage in just two simple steps.
pins.what: Two steps is the proof of your idea, and it reads like a spec.
pins.why: A routine this short is the clearest sign that you mean needing less.
pins.how: Turn the two steps into the signature of the brand, named and shown, not listed.
pins.label: Your routine
pins.cost: The proof of the belief stays a product detail.

sections.intro: You said something feels off and you cannot name it. I spent some time on your site. Here is my best attempt to name it.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Ayira Beauty's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Muji, from another category. Its whole brand is the confidence to sell less.
